q: Gear A turns clockwise. Which way does gear C turn?
a: Clockwise. Each gear turns the next one the opposite way: A clockwise, B anticlockwise, C clockwise.

q: Gear A has 20 teeth and gear B has 10 teeth. When A makes 1 full turn, how many turns does B make?
a: 2 turns. B has half as many teeth, so it turns twice as fast.

q: Wheel A turns clockwise. The belt is crossed. Which way does wheel B turn?
a: Anticlockwise. A crossed belt makes the second wheel turn the opposite way.

q: The load is on the left of the pivot. At which point (X, Y or Z) will you need the LEAST force to lift it?
a: Z. The farther you push from the pivot, the less force you need.

q: A 100 N load hangs from one movable pulley. Ignoring friction, how much force is needed to lift it?
a: 50 N. A single movable pulley halves the force (two rope parts share the load).

q: The tank is full of water. From which tap will water come out with the MOST force?
a: C. Water pressure is highest at the bottom of the tank.

q: On a bicycle, the front gear is big and the back gear is small. For one turn of the pedals, the back wheel turns:
a: More than once. The small back gear turns faster than the big front gear.
